cohort: Seven Essure® patients who sought medical consultation for various complications following hysteroscopic sterilisation.
finding: The study provides evidence of Essure® contraceptive coil migration, tissue perforation, and spontaneous expulsion in symptomatic patients, with some requiring hysterectomy.
followup_time: Average duration of exposure to Essure® coils was 25.6 months (range 5-67 months)
